summary.intent: Run the GSD manager command center to discuss, plan, and execute phases 42–44 (gap-closure phases from a UAT audit: API unpin integrity, FUSE write durability, IPNS conflict handling) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 (API unpin integrity) was fully completed — 8 plans executed across 3 worktree-isolated waves, all tests passing, code review done, live-DB schema verified, and phase marked complete. Phases 43 and 44 were discussed and CONTEXT.md files written; planning and execution remain pending.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) was protected only by JwtAuthGuard with no ownership check — any account holder could destroy another user's content by sending a harvested CID with their own JWT.

Kubo v0.40 runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly; the server profile only disables local-network discovery, not public DHT participation — so all pinned CIDs are broadcast as provider records and are harvestable by DHT crawlers.
shared-write.ts:450 drops prunedCids without calling unpin, meaning there is no legitimate cross-user unpin code path in the current codebase.
The upload compensation path in ipfs.controller.ts fires a global pin/rm on any CID without ownership checks, creating a content-addressed dedup cross-user unpin vector.
BYO (Bring Your Own) IPFS provider integration had broken unpin in both directions; the new guardedUnpin semantics fix the server-side path for free ('not pinned' is swallowed).

pnpm/jest flag forwarding is broken: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` causes pnpm to insert '--', making jest treat the flag as a positional regex. Must use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'` instead.

1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git Bash calls; agent errors require restarting the 1Password desktop app. NEVER use --no-gpg-sign as PRs enforce signatures.
The gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative even when the commit actually landed — always verify with git log, never blind-retry.
No .prettierignore existed in the repo, causing prettier to mangle .planning/ markdown files and break test command regexes embedded in VALIDATION.md tables.
The worktree cleanup helper is not idempotent — already-merged entries report 'branch_mismatch' on rerun. Must write reduced manifests containing only remaining unmerged entries.
The cleanup-wave helper resolves repoRoot from its cwd — must always be run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp). Server profile does NOT disable public DHT — only local-network mDNS discovery. All pinned CIDs are advertised as provider records.
Upload compensation path fires a global ipfsProvider.unpinFile on a CID without ownership checks — can unpin a content-addressed blob shared with another user.

Client-side unpin calls swallow errors with .catch(logger.warn) — no current caller reads the HTTP response, making the status code choice (2XX vs 403) a forward-looking API contract decision rather than a behavioral one.

New guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete + refcount in one transaction → insert pending_unpins if last reference → commit → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempts log audit metric and return silent 2XX.
BullMQ WorkerHost with drainPendingUnpins (error-isolated per row, calls provider not raw Kubo, publishes gauge) and runDriftReport (read-only NDJSON parse, zero .delete() calls in drift path).

workflow: In GSD worktree execution, the EXPECTED_BASE SHA check in worktree_branch_check must match exactly — diverged worktrees will fail the manifest validation and must be manually inspected.
Never run full monorepo test suites inside GSD subagents (RAM constraint) — always use targeted --testPathPattern or --testNamePattern filters.
Stage specific files only in git commits (never git add . or -A) to avoid accidentally committing .env, secrets, or large binaries.
When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), `git commit --no-edit` concludes it — do not abort and restart.
openapi.json can accumulate formatting-only drift from `nest build` side effects; always `git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json` before worktree merges to avoid false conflicts.
The GSD decision coverage gate uses mechanical grep for literal 'D-NN:' citation strings in plan must_haves — plans must include the exact citation format, not just satisfy the decision intent.
The gsd-code-reviewer review is advisory-only and must not block the close-out pipeline regardless of findings — always proceed to verify_phase_goal after review completes.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures mid-session requiring user to restart the desktop app; blocked multiple commit attempts and required dangerouslyDisableSandbox on all git operations.
Planner agent hit a socket error after writing plans 01-03, requiring filesystem verification of existing plans and a continuation agent for plans 04-08.
gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' false negatives — caused wasted blind-retry attempts before the verify-with-git-log pattern was established.
Worktree cleanup helper not idempotent — already-merged entries report 'branch_mismatch' forcing manual reduced-manifest workarounds.
zsh multi-glob rm (e.g., `rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules`) aborts entirely if any glob misses — must use single explicit paths.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD with all conflicts auto-resolved but the commit step failed — required manual `git commit --no-edit` and worktree/branch cleanup.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side effects created false merge conflicts that had to be restored with git checkout before each wave merge.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failure because the mechanical grep requires a literal 'D-07:' citation string — required editing 42-03-PLAN.md must_haves to add the exact citation.
pnpm/jest flag forwarding issue (pnpm inserts '--' separator) blocked targeted test runs in gates; required switching to `pnpm exec jest` invocation pattern.
No .prettierignore existed, causing prettier to mangle .planning/ markdown and break test command regexes in VALIDATION.md — had to create it mid-planning.

BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring — server-side semantics fixed by Phase 42, but client-side BYO integration still broken; deferred.
Writable-share prunedCids leak — shared-write.ts:450 drops pruned CIDs without unpinning them; out of Phase 42 scope, deferred.
Rust FUSE merge path parity with Phase 43 write queue — Rust implementation deferred; Phase 43 covers TypeScript SDK and platform-specific plans.
Read-only drift report (runDriftReport in pending-unpin processor) surfaces orphaned pins — a human operator process for reviewing and acting on drift reports is not yet defined.
